messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — RevOps flagged FluxSolv as a renewal watch. We saw a sustained 15% tail latency increase and ~18% token cost bump last week. Renewal signal is live. Thinking quick wins: int8 quant pilot + model hop to redwood-compact-1 + split routing (80/20) to dedicated during peak. Can we validate impact and risks?
Dylan (SE): Do we have request distribution by path & seq len? that will drive batching/kv cache benefits.
Ajay (RE): I pulled a sample — most heavy requests are customer support TL;DRs, median seq 512 but 10% > 2048 (those drive cost). int8 should be safe for ~90% of traffic but need eval set.
Sara (PM): Timeline wise we need something to show FluxSolv before EOW to calm renewal. Can we run a canary and a customer-facing summary? I'll prep comms.
Dylan (SE): I'll drop a quick heatmap. tagging @Ajay — can you run evals on the 500k prompt sample for generation fidelity (ROUGE/EMB drift) for int8 vs fp16?
Ajay (RE): Yep — starting now. Quick note: for long-tail >2048 we should route to standard model to avoid degredation. propose routing split: 80% compact-int8, 15% standard-fp16, 5% fallback on dedicated high-mem.
OpsBot: [monitoring alert] fluxsolv-prod latency_spike window=2025-09-29T12:40Z->2025-09-29T13:10Z p95=1.2s p99=2.8s token_cost_change=+18%
Maria (CS): Good catch. @Dylan can you prototype routing change in staging and give perf delta? keep config simple so we can snapshot results for customer.
Dylan (SE): On it. I'll add a staging route + batching tweak. Snippet I plan to apply (staging):
```
route {
  match: path: "/v1/generate"
  condition: "seq_len <= 1024"
  split: "80/20"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-highmem"
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_tokens: 2048 }
```
Ajay (RE): Also will run quality A/B: fidelity + hallucination heuristics. I'll post summary with delta table.
Sara (PM): Once we have numbers, I'll draft a 1-pager: expected cost delta, latency improvement, QA notes, and recommended rollback criteria. We should also ask FluxSolv for two sample failure cases.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Dylan — staging route & perf numbers (ETA 4h). 2) Ajay — quant/fidelity eval (ETA 6h). 3) Sara — customer note template + ask for failure samples (ETA EOD). 4) I'll pull renewal health brief and loop AE.
Dylan (SE): Quick Q: do we want to try prefix caching enabled for the 80%? that could shave 10-20% more cost.
Ajay (RE): Yes, but test both: prefix_kv on vs off — include in eval matrix.
Maria (CS): Perfect. Any blockers?
Dylan (SE): No blockers. will post logs & perf dashboard link here when ready. :mag_right:
Ajay (RE): Uploading eval artifacts to the shared folder, will ping.
OpsBot: [deploybot] staging-route applied by dylan at 2025-09-29T14:12Z (id: deploy_4821123499)
Maria (CS): Thanks team — small, measurable improvements + clear rollback = good chance to reduce renewal friction. I'll update the AE after we have numbers. :thumbsup:
